item.title: Ontario city turns to landfill property for snow storage amid record winter
item.description: With snow storage at capacity, Barrie has turned to vacant land at a landfill, as officials say this winter’s clean up is one of the largest and costliest the city has faced.

item.title: Canadian Olympic athletes happy to see NHLers back
item.description: Ivanie Blondin remembers the moment Sidney Crosby walked through the door.

item.title: Parents plead for return of plaque honouring Brentwood 5 massacre victims in Calgary
item.description: Calgary police are looking for a bronze plaque honouring the Brentwood Five, which was recently discovered missing by the mom of one of the victims killed at a house party in 2014.

item.title: ‘I’m absolutely terrified’: Advocates say changes to Sask. disability benefits concerning
item.description: Disability advocates in Saskatchewan say they have been left in the dark after the government introduced changes to Saskatchewan's disability income program, known as SAID.

item.title: Warm spell in Saskatchewan impacts outdoor winter activities
item.description: With temperatures wavering above zero, walkways are being affected and city officials in Regina and Saskatoon are advising drivers to stay alert on roads.

item.title: ‘Fly high my angel’: 12-year-old girl dies by suicide amid bullying allegations
item.description: Her father, Ryan Marshall, says Lexi was once confident and outgoing, but that began to change when she entered middle school. She was 12 years old when she took her own life.

item.title: Nanaimo break-in suspect struggled with sobriety, says former employer
item.description: Owner Andrew Reynolds’ security camera filmed the man helping himself to food and even cooking a meal, before vandalizing some of the furniture on board.

item.title: Criticism over B.C. government’s handling of Texada grizzly bear shooting
item.description: Kody Bevan and Seneca Antony received a combined penalty of $6,000, with $2,000 from each fine directed to the Habitat Conservation Trust Foundation.
